question_text: How many detections had low confidence today, say below 85%?
answer_text: There were 56,649 detections with confidence below 85% today.

citations.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(timestamp_epoch_s) AS min_time, MAX(timestamp_epoch_s) AS max_time FROM events
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_confidence_detections
FROM events
WHERE confidence < 0.85
  AND timestamp_epoch_s BETWEEN (SELECT min_time FROM bounds) AND (SELECT max_time FROM bounds)
